summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Next Day Disclosure Return on Form 6-K reporting an open-market share repurchase on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The issuer bought back 201,500 ordinary shares at HKD 21.20085 per share, representing 0.0215% of pre-repurchase issued shares; the shares are held as treasury. The board confirms the buyback was duly authorised and compliant with all listing rules. The filing is a routine post-trade disclosure for a capital return program. Watch for continued buyback activity as it reduces float and may support share price.
